provenance: Synthetic deterministic fixtures, authored for Hopp development. These are not captured SBB journeys, actual departures, or evidence that a sprint route is safe.
clock: Each mock session anchors synthetic timestamps to the query time/current time; all offsets are seconds.

scenarios.happy: Zürich Central to platform 11: 300 seconds available, 10 minute arrival gain, walking cannot catch it. Basel IWB to platform 20 uses 185 seconds.
scenarios.nohack: A direct train journey with no supported sprint route.
scenarios.late: Starts catchable, then the first tram stationboard refresh introduces five minutes of delay.
scenarios.passed: The tram passed the alight stop two minutes ago.
scenarios.ratelimit: HTTP-200-style rate-limit error represented by ApiBusyError.
scenarios.unknown: Candidate platform is unpublished; a GO recommendation must not appear.
scenarios.missing: The initial route succeeds, but live stationboards return no matching trips. Freshness must not advance.
